title: Voicecut cue directive
description: Optional JSON line after each SRT subtitle block in .voicecut.srt files.

media.description: Still, clip, or procedural / function call.

kind.description: call = procedural; text = typography / transcription (see fn or ref)

ref.description: Filename or path under episode media/, e.g. brian-johnson-newspaper.jpg

fn.description: When kind=call: function id, e.g. animated_title, ken_burns_stack

args.description: Arbitrary parameters for fn (text, font, duration, etc.)

effects.description: Stack of look modifiers: film_grain, halftone, slow_zoom, slow_spin, tilt_left, tilt_right, slow_scroll_up, vignette, ...

oneOf.description: e.g. none, film_burn, broken_film, flame, light_leak

notes.description: Human-facing: continuity, framing, legal, mood, or edit reminders (not sent to generative APIs unless you choose to).

prompt.description: Optional full instruction for an LLM / image-video model / procedural renderer when media.kind is call or when sourcing is TBD.
